rows.note: Model actively tries to violate the SOP. Quality is expected to collapse; safety must not move.

claims.description: Every required/forbidden element policy.py can emit is a known member of the guard's vocabulary, and each one either has a matcher or is explicitly delegated to another rule family.
claims.why_it_matters: check_contract() used to skip unknown elements silently. 11 of 20 declared elements had no matcher and were never checked at all — including 'an offer to request the policyholder's consent', a live R8 requirement.

claims.description: Every way a session can end is declared once, in types.END_REASONS, and every consumer resolves against it rather than keeping a private copy.
claims.why_it_matters: Five overlapping representations of 'why did this end' (phase, escalation_reason, terminal_reason, route, disposition code) were kept in sync by hand. Needing a consistency test between internal representations is the smell.

claims.description: Each directive states which mechanism enforces it: structural (the data or tool is absent), deterministic (code decides), guard (an output rule blocks it), or advisory (tone only — nothing enforces it, and that is admitted).
claims.why_it_matters: SEND_NOW never fired once for an entire build. The email went out anyway because the model volunteered the tool call. A directive feels like enforcement and is not; making the backing explicit is what stops that feeling being load-bearing.

claims.description: Every event name the frontend emits is known to the metrics sink.
claims.why_it_matters: record_event() drops unknown names silently, so a renamed event becomes a metric that quietly reads zero forever — indistinguishable from 'this never happens'.

claims.description: Phase names hard-coded in the frontend correspond to real engine phases.
claims.why_it_matters: The UI keys copy and layout off phase strings. A renamed phase leaves the interface silently rendering nothing for it.

verdict.thesis: Safety guarantees are enforced by the harness, not by model quality.
